summary: Level-5's Studio Ghibli-inspired RPG series, spanning the DS original, HD console/PC entries, and mobile/service spin-offs.

entries.title: Ni no Kuni: Dominion of the Dark Djinn

emulation.notes: Use legal cartridge dumps and a readable dual-screen capture layout.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native DS rendering with clean scaling.

primary.version: Original Japanese Nintendo DS release via melonDS
primary.why: Dominion of the Dark Djinn is the original DS version and was released only in Japan; the later Wrath of the White Witch is an enhanced, separately developed version and is tracked separately.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped Japanese DS cartridge in melonDS if covering the original version. Expect Japanese text and the original DS/magic-book interface.

all_releases.fidelity: Only release of the DS original.
all_releases.reason: primary: sole platform for this original DS version; DS emulation is the cleanest capture route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Wrath of the White Witch is an enhanced, separately developed version and has its own entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: Japan-only DS original; not the same product as the later HD releases.

entries.title: Ni no Kuni: Hotroit Stories

emulation.notes: Preservation-only unless lawful original mobile access exists.

primary.why: Hotroit Stories was a Roid mobile-service prequel released as the first chapter only; no current commercial version or port is documented.
primary.how_to_play: There is no normal current play route. Treat this as a preservation entry unless you have lawful archived access to the original mobile release.

all_releases.reason: primary: only documented release, now a preservation-limited route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The only release was a mobile service title and is not currently available through a normal storefront.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remake, port, or archive release is documented.

entries.title: Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch
entries.definitive_edition: Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch Remastered

primary.version: Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch Remastered
primary.why: The remaster improves graphics and performance on PS4 and PC, and the PC release has the highest capture/settings ceiling among the modern versions.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on PC at the highest stable resolution and frame rate. Use console remasters only when PC is unavailable.

all_releases.reason: skip: original release, superseded in fidelity by the remaster.

all_releases.fidelity: Switch port of the non-remastered version.
all_releases.reason: skip: portable console route, but not the highest-fidelity remastered route.

all_releases.fidelity: Remastered console release with improved graphics and performance.
all_releases.reason: skip: excellent console route, but PC has the higher capture ceiling.
primary: highest-fidelity modern route with PC settings and capture flexibility.
skip: strong current console route, but PC remains the best capture choice.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The modern remaster is the best fidelity route; the DS original is a separate entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Switch release is a port of the original rather than the PS4/PC remaster.

entries.title: Ni no Kuni: Daibouken Monsters

emulation.notes: Preservation-only unless lawful original mobile access exists.

primary.why: Daibouken Monsters was a GREE social card RPG and has no documented modern port or current storefront route.
primary.how_to_play: There is no normal current play route. Treat this as a preservation entry unless lawful archived access to the original service client exists.

all_releases.reason: primary: only documented release, now a preservation-limited route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The original service title is no longer a normal current play route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remake, port, or archive release is documented.

entries.title: Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom

primary.why: Prince's Edition bundles the base game, Tale of a Timeless Tome, Lair of the Lost Lord, and bonus DLC, while the PC version has the best capture/settings ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam Prince's Edition or equivalent complete PC package with all story expansions installed before starting the main archive run.

all_releases.reason: skip: strong original route, but complete DLC packaging and PC capture make the PC Prince's Edition preferable.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with complete Prince's Edition option.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity/capture route and complete DLC packaging.
skip: complete portable route, but lower capture/fidelity ceiling than PC.
skip: strong current console route, but PC remains the preferred capture version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PC Prince's Edition gives both the preferred fidelity route and complete DLC package.

entries.remaster_caveats: Choose a complete Prince's Edition package or install the expansion DLC before the run.

entries.title: Ni no Kuni: Cross Worlds

emulation.notes: Use the official PC client rather than mobile emulation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC client for a mobile/live-service game.

primary.why: Cross Worlds is a live-service mobile/PC RPG; the official PC client is the cleanest stream-capture route, while mobile remains the native storefront route.
primary.how_to_play: Install through the official PC client after creating/linking the required mobile account, then capture the PC window. Re-check service availability before planning a stream.

all_releases.reason: skip: native mobile route, but PC client is better for capture.
skip: native mobile route, but PC client is better for capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Official PC client for the live-service game.
all_releases.reason: primary: best practical stream-capture route for the active service.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: As a live-service game, completeness depends on current server availability and event/content rotation rather than a fixed boxed release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service content may change or disappear; verify current service state before streaming.
